scale: tiles: 12x PNG, map draws them at 0.5 (6x). HUD: 12x PNG, drawn at 1/3 (4x)

tiles.path: paths are strokes: ellipses w=6 logical, colour 138/106/64, speckles 118/90/54 and 160/128/80
tiles.tree: tree.png, forests are random clusters sorted by y
tiles.fog: fog_edge.png along every map border (rotate per side)

hud.topbar: y 0..48 px, stone.png tiled, 1px black line under; resources = res-*.png + Press Start 2P 32px, colour 255/230/120, red 255/80/70 when exhausted
hud.panel: y 1424..1920 px: minimap 248x248 inset at (16,1456), info box inset (312,1456)-(1064,1648) with portrait_frame + idle_0 of the selected object, name white, status coloured, HP bar 84x12; command buttons 6 in a row from (312,1672), 124 px step
hud.message: top-left of the map, Press Start 2P 32px, 255/230/120 with 4px black shadow, max 2 lines, 3 s
hud.select: select.png around the selected unit + HP bar 10x1 logical (green 60/230/60 on 40/0/0) above it

marks.files: ui/mark-<name>_<i>.png, 12x12 logical, frames: bang 2, question 1, wait 1, dots 3, zzz 3 (4 fps)
marks.place: bottom of the mark 2 logical px above the unit sprite top; for crowd units that have no such state (warrior waiting in a queue)
